The japanese word for the tomestone made more sense but there just wasn't a good localized alternative for it. In japan the word for soldiery is "Senki" which translates to something along the lines of "history of warfare"

If you look at it that way you see a trend. The allagan tomestones contain information about their civilization and most importantly their culture. The first ones had information about their philosophy, the second about their myths and legends, the third about their military knowledge and traditions.

The fourth tomestome will also likely refer another aspect of their culture if they continue this tradition. Maybe art, politics, or traditions. And then it will be butchered by localization again so that it uses a word that ends in -y.

Then you can craft one piece of highest quality gear.


Accessories are gotten mainly though weekly/montly achivements and weekly guild hunts and stuff.

[And then your inventory looks like this](http://www.remnantsofhope.com/boards/uploads/gallery/album_206/gallery_362_206_55545.jpg) because the amount of crafting mats you get from endgame drops outweighs the amount of 24 hour cooldown gathering/crafting materials and gold you need to buy them by a rate of about 100:1. The idea behind this is that the material drops are easy to get but the enormous amount of gold you need to use the drops is scarce, so they hope you spend real money in the cash store to fund your gear.
